description: Removal and replacement of existing combustible cladding and external wall elements with new non-combustible and associated works
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin no later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the following approved plans:
TCP and TPP BladeCourt May_2026
Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved and is compliant with development plan policy.

The proposed development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the materials detailed under on the following drawings unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the proposed development will harmonise with the character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in strict accordance with the measures detailed on the approved Tree Constraints and Protection Plan (Drawing ref: TCP and TPP_BladeCourt_May_2026). Specifically, protective fencing shall be securely attached to any scaffolding erected around trees T1 to T9 to restrict access beneath the tree canopy. The tree protection measures shall be fully installed prior to the commencement of any site setup, scaffolding erection, or remediation works, and shall be maintained in place until all construction activity has ceased. No materials, machinery, or refuse shall be stored, nor fires lit, within the tree protection zone beneath trees T1-T9.

Reason:To ensure that existing trees adjacent to the development are adequately protected during construction in the interests of visual amenity, environmental quality, and biodiversity, in accordance with Policy 27 of the Havering Local Plan, Policy G7 of the London Plan, and the National Planning P

The Local Planning Authority has acted positively and proactively in determining this application by assessing the proposal against all material planning considerations, including planning policies and any representations which were received.  It subsequently determined to grant planning permission in accordance with the National Planning Policy requirement that applications for sustainable development are approved where possible. A detailed analysis of the scheme is set out in the report on the application prepared by officers.

It does not give consent for an permanent or temporary changes to the public highway, the use of the public highway for the storage of materials or placing of apparatus associated with the construction or other processes, nor does it permit the discharge of surface water onto the public highway.  You are encouraged to check whether or not works or activities necessitate separate consents under the requirements of other, non-planning legislation at the earliest opportunity by emailing environmentbusinesssupport@havering.gov.uk for further information.  Unauthorised work on or use of the public highway and a failure to prevent the discharge of surface water on to the public highway area all an offence.
